A.config: config.json: Kolibri1ForCausalLM, model_type kolibri1, 50 layers (40 sliding_attention window 513 + 10 full_attention NoPE, 4:1 interleave), hidden 2560, 48 q / 4 kv heads, head_dim 128, 384 experts top-6 + 1 shared (I=512), sigmoid routing with selection-only expert bias, no renorm, vocab 128000, max_position_embeddings 262144, eos 127906, pad 127901, FP8 e4m3 weights in 128x128 blocks, head_dtype float32
A.generation_config: do_sample=true, temperature=1.0, top_p=0.97, top_k=128, eos_token_id=[127906, 127901], pad_token_id=127901
A.tokenizer: tokenizer.json + tokenizer_config.json (PreTrainedTokenizerFast, chat template with reasoning_effort / enable_thinking, eos <|im_end|>)
A.task_heads: AutoModel registry: kolibri1 is not a transformers model type. The only head the checkpoint ships is the causal LM (architectures=[Kolibri1ForCausalLM], pipeline_tag text-generation). The reference is the torch port in tests/pcc/_reference_loader.py (op-for-op port of the aleph-alpha-inference vLLM plugin; fp32 forward, FP8 weights dequantised on the fly).
A.golden: the reference model's forward/generation (fp32) with the SAME sampling rule as the TT side: generation_config top_k=128 -> top_p=0.97 -> temperature 1.0, token drawn by inverse CDF with one seeded uniform per (sample, step).

B.bringup_output: models/demos/kolibri_1 (copied from models/tt_transformers/demo/kolibri_1, where auto-up persisted it; emit-e2e resolves the demo dir under models/demos). Stub imports repointed models.tt_transformers.demo.kolibri_1 -> models.demos.kolibri_1; bodies otherwise byte-identical to their snapshots.

graduated_modules_verified.rule: graduated = _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native or .last_good_sharded exists (checked on disk); the live _stubs/<name>.py is byte-identical to that snapshot

not_graduated.model: harness-skipped (no snapshot): its body is a loop over decoder_layer + embed + final norm; the pipeline in tt/ composes exactly that from the graduated parts instead
not_graduated.encoder_stack: REUSE/ADAPT tag with no submodule in this model (no encoder) - nothing to route
not_graduated.layer: ADAPT tag (llama_layernorm) with no submodule in this model - nothing to route
not_graduated.mlp: REUSE tag (swiglu_mlp) duplicate of m_l_p with no submodule path - nothing to route

graduated_modules_verified.helper_not_a_component: _stubs/_kolibri_moe.py (TtKolibri1MoE): shared implementation that the decoder_layer and sparse_moe_block stubs import

task_heads.input: chat messages -> tokenizer.apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False) -> input_ids [B, T]; B = $TT_PERF_BATCH (32)
task_heads.output: generated token ids per sample until the model's own stop token, decoded to text
stub_routing: token_embed: input ids (uint32 on device) -> embeddings, for the prompt (prefill) and for each sampled token (decode)
decoder_layer x50: the graduated layer body (sandwich norms + residual) wraps the attention and the MoE below; a common subclass adds the KV-cache decode path

attention: the stub's fused-qkv / q,k-norm / RoPE / sliding SDPA weights and helpers, plus resident K,V caches (prefill fill_cache of all B users at once; decode paged_update_cache + SDPA-decode) and SDPA at fp32 accumulation
f_p8_linear: the attention output projection o_proj (column-parallel over the hidden dim + all_gather), fed the all-gathered heads
sparse_moe_block: every layer's MLP (expert-parallel routed experts, expert matmuls at HiFi4)
router: the router logits inside sparse_moe_block's routing, fed the fp32 normed hidden state (cut the last-position TV to the fp32 reference from 0.012 to 0.002)
m_l_p: the ungated shared expert inside sparse_moe_block (TP-split SwiGLU + all_reduce), summed with the routed experts
r_m_s_norm: the final model norm before the head
decoder_head: the LM head (vocab-parallel + all_gather) producing the logits the on-device sampler reads
task_heads.sampling: on device, fp32: topk(128) -> softmax -> top-p 0.97 (exclusive cumsum < p) -> kept set by logit cut -> exp, cumsum in TOKEN-ID order -> count(cdf <= u * z) -> token id; u = per-(sample, position) uniform from torch.Generator(seed b), uploaded once as a resident table and selected by an exact one-hot sum
task_heads.stop_rule: per sample, stop at generation_config eos_token_id (127906 <|im_end|> or 127901); safety cap = min(max_position_embeddings - prompt_len, KV capacity C); the correctness run asserts every sample ended on its stop token, not on the cap (skip that assert only when TT_PERF_OSL_TOKENS is set)
task_heads.pass: all 9 graduated modules invoked inside the generation forward (Gate 2), every routed stub still the graduated ttnn body (Gate 1), every sample's final-output logits PCC >= 0.99 vs the fp32 reference (Gate 3), prefill hidden PCC >= 0.995 + norm ratio within 0.5%, TT tokens equal to the reference's on every decisive step, and discrete agreement no worse than the reference's own bf16-activation run (margin 0.02)
task_heads.validation_metric: per sample b: PCC of all of b's step logits (TT vs the reference teacher-forced onto the same prefixes, one causal fp32 forward over prompt+generated); FINAL_PCC = min over the B samples, printed as `e2e PCC=<value>` before the final assert
behavioral_proof: decoded text of every sample printed; outputs differ across seeds (asserted)
device sampler == host sampler on the TT logits at every step (exact, fp32 vs fp64 ties only)
TT token == reference token (same uniform) at every decisive step: reference sampling margin > 2 x TV(TT, reference)
decisive share and token agreement >= the reference's own bf16-activation run vs its fp32 run (golden.precision_baseline) - 0.02

independent free-running reference (cached): prefill hidden PCC >= 0.995 (min over rows) and |tt|/|ref| within 0.5%; prompt-position logits PCC >= 0.99; the free-running TT output may leave the reference's trajectory only at a non-decisive step
every sample ends on the model's stop token, not the KV-capacity cap (skipped only when TT_PERF_OSL_TOKENS is set)
task_heads.batch: B=32 from $TT_PERF_BATCH; same prompt for all rows, row b uses seed b (the sampling axis generation_config exposes); prints PERF_BATCH_STREAMS=<B>
task_heads.input_provenance: user message 'Erklaere kurz, was ein Mixture-of-Experts-Modell ist.' from the model card's 'Querying the server' example (Source A README), chat template with enable_thinking=False (the card's documented 'disable thinking' mode) - recorded beside the test

agents: one call (text_generation) -> one builder; all 9 graduated modules sit in that single call, so no parallel split
placement: ttnn.set_fabric_config(FABRIC_1D) then the test fixture opens MeshShape(1,4); TP=4: attention heads 12q/1kv per chip, experts 96 per chip, shared expert / lm_head / o_proj split, embeddings + norms + router replicated; DP=1 (ReplicateTensorToMesh for inputs)
memory: registered QB2 figures: 32 GB DRAM per chip, 28.6 GB usable per chip with a CCL axis in play (TP=4). Weights ~22 GB/chip (bf8 routed experts), leaving ~6 GB/chip for KV caches + activations; KV capacity C chosen inside that budget

trace_contract.factory: tt/pipeline.py::build_pipeline(device, model=None, layers=None, prefill_layers=None, decode_layers=None, **kwargs) -> resident pipeline object
trace_contract.items: prefill: B x padded prompt length tokens; decode: B tokens per step

self_validation: static: grep the hot path for torch compute / HF submodule calls (none allowed); every stub file still byte-equal to its snapshot (only the import path was repointed)
Gate 1: each routed stub class instance is the graduated class (or a subclass of it) and runs ttnn ops only; _runtime_fallbacks.json stays empty
Gate 2: per-module invocation counters wrapped around the 9 graduated callables during the real generation; test asserts every count > 0 and prints them
Gate 3: e2e PCC per sample >= 0.99 printed and asserted; prefill hidden-state floor 0.995 + norm ratio 0.5%
trace: trace_capture_selftest per stage on device; host_op_selftest returns a clean verdict
pre-commit hooks run over the emitted files
stub_text_edits: behaviour-identical edits to _stubs (live + snapshot alike) so the G6 trace probe's static regexes stop matching build-time code: torch.cat -> torch.concat in attention/_kolibri_moe weight packing; the torch-input upload locals in attention/token_embed/model renamed (positions/tokens)
